name: Sotto
rationale: Sotto borrows the intimacy of sotto voce: a thought spoken naturally, close at hand. Warm paper, plum-black ink, and a little vermilion give the app an editorial character without losing the restraint of a built-in Mac utility. The brand feels like a good writing instrument—personal, precise, and comfortable to use every day.
logoIdea: Two opposing ribbon turns form a compact S. Their open ends and diagonal pause suggest the passage from speech into writing. The mark stays solid and recognizable at menu-bar size, with no microphone, waveform, or speech bubble.

names.name: Sotto
names.reason: Short, musical, and intimate; suggests speaking naturally without making noise about it.

names.name: Vellum
names.reason: A more literary alternative that connects spoken thoughts to a lasting written page.

watchout: The name is evocative rather than explanatory. Pair it with “Local dictation for Mac” during onboarding. Naming availability has not been checked.
